question: The anthraquinone derivatives exert their laxative effect through the following mechanism:

options.opa: Attraction of water to the intestinal light by osmosis.
options.opb: Direct irritation of the mucosa or stimulation of nerve plexuses.
options.opc: Favoring the lubrication and change of consistency of the fecal bolus.
options.opd: Stimulation of motor activity due to increased intestinal content.
